title: fastpath: gated fast-path with precision toggles and safe-mode fallback for KV scheduler
author: Nina Patel
description: Context: This PR adds a gated fast-path execution path into the serving runtime's KV scheduler to reduce tail latency and improve throughput for common short-sequence workloads. The fast-path leverages lower-precision kernels (fp16 + int8 matmul kernels) and a lighter-weight KV cache handling to save compute and memory bandwidth. Because lower-precision execution can cause correctness drift for certain models and long-context scenarios, the change introduces a precision_toggle configuration per-model and a runtime safe-mode fallback that automatically routes requests to the conservative slow-path (fp32 kernels and the existing stable KV codepath) when divergence or safety checks fail. Motivation: previous attempts to enable low-precision kernels globally produced correctness regressions for a subset of models (layernorm sensitivity, long-context token instability). This PR centralizes gating in the KV scheduler, provides deterministic heuristics for fast-path eligibility, surfaces telemetry, and gives operators a controlled rollout path. What changed (high level): 1) kd_scheduler: introduce gated fast-path selection and token-alignment checks; 2) fastpath_executor: implement lower-precision execution and limited KV cache handling; 3) precision_profile: model-level config to opt-in and tune thresholds; 4) safe-mode: runtime divergence detector (log-prob divergence + token stability checks) and automatic reroute; 5) telemetry: new perf/quality metrics and rollout flags; 6) tests and benchmarks. This description includes commits summary, files changed, review conversation, CI history, and rollout notes below.
commits_summary: Add gated fast-path selection and eligibility checks in kv_scheduler (core logic)
Implement fastpath_executor with fp16/int8 kernel calls and guarded KV cache behavior
Introduce precision_profile metadata and per-model precision_toggle config
Add divergence detector and automatic safe-mode reroute logic
Add unit/integration tests and end-to-end perf harnesses
Docs: rollout guide and telemetry dashboard notes
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please add long-context (>=1024) tests showing no regression and include a signal for per-request fallback reason in traces.
Nina Patel (author): Added tests for seq=1024, 2048 and included a fallback_reason tag on traces (fastpath_mismatch|kv_misaligned|precision_threshold).
Evelyn Zhang: Telemetry looks good but we should tag model_id and route_name to make rollout metrics actionable.
Nina Patel: Added model_id and route_name tags to all fastpath metrics and added sampling controls to limit cardinality.
Marco Reyes: Small nit - refactor the eligibility check into a helper and add a LRU for recent alignment checks to avoid extra allocations.
Nina Patel: Addressed the nit, moved helper into kv_scheduler util and added a small fixed-size LRU cache.
ci_checks: Unit tests: pass (includes new fastpath unit tests)
Integration tests: initial run failed due to transient gRPC flakiness; retried and passed
benchmarks_summary: Short-sequence (seq<=128): 1.9-2.6x throughput improvement on A100-like hardware depending on model family
Tail latency p99 improved by ~25-40ms on common web workloads under modest concurrency

Long-sequence (seq>=1024): up to 6% regression in throughput for some models when forced through fast-path; safe-mode fallback prevents user-visible regression by routing those requests to slow-path; observed negligible quality drift after safe-mode thresholds were applied
testing: Unit: new tests for eligibility, alignment, and divergence detection
Integration: e2e test against chat-example with long-context transcripts
Perf: microbench harness added under benchmarks/fastpath to compare fp32 vs fp16+int8 kernels
Fuzz: small randomized inputs to ensure KV alignment invariants hold across seq lengths
rollout_plan: Gradual rollout via model metadata opt-in: set precision_toggle=true in model_config for target models
Stage 0 (canary): 1% traffic for selected stable models for 48h with elevated telemetry
Stage 1: 10% traffic for 72h if no regression alerts
Stage 2: 50% traffic then 100% after 7 days if SLOs and quality metrics are stable
Immediate automatic safe-mode fallback in production if divergence thresholds exceeded; operators can force-disable fastpath via runtime flag
release_notes: Introduce gated fast-path in KV scheduler with per-model precision toggles and an automatic safe-mode fallback to preserve correctness. Provides up to 2.6x throughput improvement on short-sequence workloads and adds telemetry and rollout controls. Opt-in model configuration required. Not enabled by default.
